message: DIS-001 cannot be executed by an AI agent. roadmap.md marks it 'Recommended model: human (Management/Advisor) -- not an agent task' and 'Verification commands: n/a (human)'. Deliverables are real import files that must be produced by and verified accepted by the actual LEPTON and KDT Optimizer software, plus written answers to every format question in integration-contracts.md 1-2 (columns+order, units, decimal separator, delimiter, encoding, grain/rotation, material/thickness, edge-band, required-vs-optional). This sandbox has no access to LEPTON or KDT Optimizer and cannot verify acceptance by the real software. Architectural invariant 'executors must never invent these formats' forbids fabricating values to fake completion. Within-scope action: created discovery/optimizers/format-notes.md as an UNANSWERED scaffold of all format questions + unblock path; invented no values. Acceptance criteria unmet. Unblock: human with LEPTON+KDT access must (1) place one real accepted import file per optimizer in discovery/optimizers/, (2) answer every question in format-notes.md in writing, (3) screenshot software import screens if written specs unavailable. INT-001 and INT-002 remain hard-blocked until then.
